item.title: Roger Gale Taylor, 71 of Mize, Mississippi - MageeNews.com
item.description: Roger Gale Taylor, 71 of Mize, MS passed away Thursday, November 20, 2025. He was born Tuesday, March 23, 1954 in Laurel, MS. Visitation will be held on Monday, November 24, 2025 from 9:30 am until the funeral service at 11:00 am at Colonial Chapel Funeral Home of Magee, 302 Eighth Ave SW, Magee, MS.
